summary_1line: Madhavi bears a son to King Usinara, then Galava—unable to obtain all required horses—offers her and six hundred steeds to Viswamitra.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Usinara and the radiant maiden Madhavi wander through mountain valleys and gardens as fountains and waterfalls sparkle around them.
Galava stands before the sage Viswamitra with six hundred pale horses while the beautiful Madhavi waits beside him under forest hermitage trees.
Garuda speaks with Galava, explaining the lost horses as the mighty bird towers beside the thoughtful Brahmana.
